caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a decorative, dark brown or black leather saddle skirt with an intricate pattern stitched in orange and blue thread. The skirt features a scalloped edge and three distinct lines of border stitching, with a large leaf or feather-like motif in the center outlined in blue. The left side of the image shows this tooled leather piece in full color, while to the right, a partially sketched outline continues, showing the remainder of the saddle in a much lighter, unfinished pencil or ink style. Above the unfinished portion, the number “255” is inscribed, and a circular button or fastener is visible. At the bottom right of the colored section, the name “HARRY MAIN WADDELL” is written in small, capital letters. The background is a plain, off-white or beige tone with some shading beneath the saddle skirt.
title: Side Saddle - California Syle
